description: The b1 conformance corpus (Bundle §13): one directory per case, each with bundle.json, inputs.json, expected-report.json and expected-exit. README.md describes the cases; Bundle §13.3 states how to replay one.
source: Generated from one run of Tzun's reference implementation, anchoring a local store under the namespace test.bundle-b1.tzun on anvil (ghcr.io/foundry-rs/foundry:v1.5.1, chain id 31337, finalized = head - 2), publishing from anvil's development account 5, its clock 3600 s behind the wall clock, with a local RFC 3161 authority under a throwaway CA whose tokens meet Anchor §10.5 (DER, a signingCertificateV2, a critical timestamping-only extendedKeyUsage). The expected reports are stated from Verification, Bundle and Anchor §10.

cases.name: anchored-with-newer
cases.description: A record anchored in epoch 1 whose log and anchor log grew in epoch 2: its own anchor, the newer anchor and both consistency proofs hold with the manifest, a header source and the TSA root (Bundle §7.5, §7.6; Anchor §10.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: anchored-offline
cases.description: The same bundle verified with no trust inputs: every publication, the timestamp's trust and both consistency checks are not checked. Exit 4 (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: anchored-offline-allow-unchecked
cases.description: The same, with --allow-unchecked: exit 0, every NOT CHECKED line still in the report (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: anchored-no-header-source
cases.description: The manifest and the TSA root, no header source: the transaction's offline facts hold and never make the publication true (Anchor §10.4). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchored-not-final
cases.description: A header source whose finalized height is below both publications' blocks: evm_block_not_finalized, with the finality it judged by (Anchor §10.4 items 10 and 14). Exit 4.

cases.name: timestamp-untrusted
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token verifies, and chains to no root the auditor supplied: ts.record.trust not checked, no_matching_trust_anchor (Anchor §10.5 step 4). Exit 4.

cases.name: record-token-not-der
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token with its TSTInfo in a constructed (BER) OCTET STRING, which decodes to the same bytes and is not DER: ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token, and ts.record.trust blocked by it (Anchor §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-no-signing-certificate
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token, validly signed, whose signed attributes carry neither a signingCertificate nor a signingCertificateV2, so nothing binds its signer certificate: ts.record.token checked-wrong, verification_failed (Anchor §10.5 step 3). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-no-timestamping-eku
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate of the same name under the root the auditor supplied, with no extendedKeyUsage: not a timestamping certificate, so ts.record.token checked-wrong, verification_failed, whatever root it chains to (Anchor §10.5 step 3). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-digest-algorithms-malformed
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token, validly signed, whose SignedData.digestAlgorithms holds a bare OBJECT IDENTIFIER where a SET OF AlgorithmIdentifier belongs. The set is not signed, so anyone can change it: ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token (Anchor §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-unreadable-certificate
cases.description: The record's genuine RFC 3161 token with one certificate added to its unsigned certificates set: a CA certificate of the root's name whose public key is not a point on its curve. A certificate whose key does not decode is not a certificate, so ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token, and every other check is still reported (Anchor §10.1, §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-issuer-name-reencoded
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate the supplied root did issue, whose issuer name writes the root's CN as a UTF8String where the root's subject writes a PrintableString. Names match byte for byte, so no path reaches the root: ts.record.token checked-correct, ts.record.trust not checked, no_matching_trust_anchor (Anchor §10.5 step 4). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchored-latest-epoch
cases.description: A record anchored in the newest epoch: one checkpoint per log, no newer anchor and no consistency check (Bundle §7.3). Exit 0.

cases.name: unanchored-awaiting-epoch
cases.description: A record no epoch has taken yet: anchorPending, never a marker in nonRepudiation; anchor absent and anchor.pending not checked, not_yet_published (Bundle §7.7). Exit 4.

cases.name: unanchored-allow-unchecked
cases.description: The same, with --allow-unchecked: exit 0 (Bundle §7.7).

cases.name: unanchored-awaiting-finality
cases.description: The same record exported after its epoch's transaction was mined and before it was final: still pending (Bundle §2, §7.7). Exit 4.

cases.name: tampered-payload
cases.description: A payload edited under its stored digest: record.digest checked-wrong once, and everything that takes the digest as input blocked by it (Verification §2.2, §4.3). Exit 1.

cases.name: envelope-version-unknown
cases.description: An envelope tagged e2, a version this verifier does not read: record.digest abstains, unsupported_envelope_version, and everything that takes the digest as input is blocked by it (Verification §2.2: an unknown tag abstains on its section). Exit 4, never a pass.

cases.name: rewrite-and-reseat
cases.description: A payload rewritten with its digest and chain link recomputed: the record reads intact, and its RFC 3161 token and both anchors are over another digest (imprint_mismatch, merkle_proof_invalid). Exit 1.

cases.name: transplanted-leaf
cases.description: Another record's artifact, from the same chain, on this record: leaf_index_mismatch; the store's material still anchors the record (anchor.newer). Exit 1.

cases.name: transplanted-chain
cases.description: An artifact from a record on another chain of the store: chain_id_mismatch (Anchor §10.3 step 2b). Exit 1.

cases.name: tampered-log-path
cases.description: One hash of the record's path in its log flipped: merkle_proof_invalid. Exit 1.

cases.name: tampered-anchor-path
cases.description: One hash of the log checkpoint's path in the anchor log flipped: anchor_proof_invalid. Exit 1.

cases.name: fabricated-header-offline
cases.description: A validly signed transaction under a self-consistent, back-dated header (its hash written into the envelope and the bundle), with no header source: anchor.evm.tx holds, anchor.evm.canonical is not checked, the publication is null, and no existedBy comes from it (Anchor §10.4). Exit 4.

cases.name: fabricated-header-with-source
cases.description: The same bundle against the auditor's header source: the block at that height has another hash, anchor_not_found_on_chain. Exit 1.

cases.name: manifest-chain-mismatch
cases.description: The manifest names the publisher on another chain than the one the transaction signed: evm_chain_mismatch (Anchor §10.4). Exit 1.

cases.name: sender-not-publisher
cases.description: The manifest names another address for the anchor origin: evm_sender_mismatch. Exit 1.

cases.name: forged-future-anchor-spec
cases.description: The record's artifact relabelled tzun-anchor/2: the verifier abstains on that section, which is never a pass. Exit 4 (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: consistency-proof-tampered
cases.description: One hash of the anchor log's consistency proof flipped, between two authenticated checkpoints: log_inconsistent_with_anchor (Anchor §10.8). Exit 1.

cases.name: consistency-proof-missing
cases.description: The evidence log's consistency proof left out: not_in_bundle:consistency_proof. Exit 4.

cases.name: newer-anchor-tampered
cases.description: One hash of the newer checkpoint's path in the newest anchor checkpoint flipped: anchor.newer anchor_proof_invalid, and the consistency it would authenticate blocked by it. Exit 1.

cases.name: split-view
cases.description: A second history of the record's log at the same size, taken into an extension of the anchor log and published with the store's own key: every anchor holds, and the two authenticated bodies of one size differ: split_view (Anchor §10.8). Exit 1.

cases.name: subject-mismatch
cases.description: A subject that does not name the envelope's digest (Bundle §5.1). Exit 1.

cases.name: witness-extension
cases.description: A value in the reserved witness/1 extension: this verifier abstains on that key only (Bundle §9). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchored-log-unchanged
cases.description: A record on another chain of the store, anchored in epoch 1, whose log did not grow while the anchor log did: one checkpoint of its log, carrying its anchor into the newest anchor checkpoint, and the anchor log's two checkpoints with their proof (Bundle §7.5; Anchor §10.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: signed-record
cases.description: A record signed at capture: its expectation is null and it carries no sign-off block, so signoff.expectation holds; its WebAuthn assertion needs a credential no slot of b1 carries, signoff.key not_in_bundle:credential (Verification §4.5, §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: signature-stripped
cases.description: A record whose hashed payload.signoffExpectation owes a signature under a sign-off policy ({ policyDigest }), signed at capture, with its WebAuthn assertion removed: a bundle cannot tell a stripped signature from one still to come, so signoff.expectation and signoff.key are not checked, signature_missing, and never absent (Verification §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: session-record
cases.description: A record captured into slot 1 of a sign-off session: { statementDigest, sessionSeq } inside its digest, written with its signoff block and an assertion that presented the session statement's challenge. signoff.expectation holds with no key; signoff.key needs a credential no slot of b1 carries (Record §6.1, Verification §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: session-signoff-stripped
cases.description: The session record with its signoff block and assertion removed: a session record is written with its sign-off (Record §6.1), so the record alone shows the removal, signoff.expectation checked-wrong, signoff_stripped, and signoff.key blocked by it (21 CFR 11.70). Exit 1, with or without --allow-unchecked.

cases.name: session-signoff-transplanted
cases.description: The session record's signoff block and assertion moved onto a record whose hashed expectation is null: signoff.expectation checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected (21 CFR 11.70). The digest does not cover nonRepudiation, so only the expectation shows it. Exit 1.

cases.name: session-signoff-without-assertion
cases.description: A record whose hashed expectation is null, carrying the session record's signoff block and no assertion: a session sign-off is the block alone, so signoff.expectation is checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected, and signoff.key blocked by it (Record §6.3, Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: policy-session-signoff-without-assertion
cases.description: A record whose hashed expectation is { policyDigest }, its assertion removed, carrying the session record's signoff block: the session rule comes before the one that reads a missing assertion as signature_missing, so signoff.expectation is checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected, and signoff.key blocked by it (Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: junk-batch-signoff
cases.description: The signed record with a batch signoff block beside its per-record assertion, whose statement has no digest, no root and no inclusion proof: a sign-off block that does not bind by the checks that need no key is never a signature carried, signoff.expectation checked-wrong, signoff_unbound (Record §6.5, Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: artifact-not-filled
cases.description: An anchored record whose envelope does not hold its artifact yet, as an exporter writes it: no artifact names the record's own checkpoints, so only the newest of each log is carried, with the record's anchor into it; anchor absent, anchor.newer holds (Bundle §7.3, §7.5). Exit 0.

cases.name: artifact-stripped
cases.description: The first bundle with the envelope's artifact removed: the record's own checkpoints are still carried, and nothing authenticates them, so neither consistency check can run (Bundle §7.6; Anchor §10.8). Exit 4.

cases.name: carried-checkpoints-contradict
cases.description: A record anchored in the newest epoch whose carried checkpoints are replaced by bodies of the same logs and sizes with other roots: nothing authenticates them, with one checkpoint per log as with two, so the consistency checks are not checked, blocked_by:anchor.newer (Bundle §7.6; Anchor §10.8). Exit 4.

cases.name: checkpoints-of-two-logs-under-one-key
cases.description: The artifact's evidence-log and anchor-log checkpoints carried together under the evidence log's key: a checkpoint sits under the key of its own origin, so the bundle cannot be read, and two logs are never compared as one (Bundle §7.1). Exit 2.

cases.name: related-records-filled
cases.description: The reserved relatedRecords slot filled: this version does not read it, so a verifier abstains on it, which is never a pass (Bundle §8). Exit 4.

cases.name: policy-filled
cases.description: The reserved policy slot filled: abstain on it, unsupported_slot (Bundle §8). Exit 4.

cases.name: unknown-member
cases.description: A top-level member a b1 record bundle does not have: abstain on it, unsupported_member, since what it carries is not examined (Bundle §3.3). Exit 4.

cases.name: unanchored-pending-stripped
cases.description: An unanchored record's bundle with anchorPending set to null: it reads as a record of a store that does not anchor, since an absent anchor is not an unchecked artifact (Verification §6.6, Bundle §7.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: unanchored-pending-stripped-require-anchor
cases.description: The same under a regime that requires the anchor: exit 3. An auditor who needs the record anchored requires anchor (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: bundle-version-unknown
cases.description: bundleVersion b2: the verifier abstains on the whole bundle (Bundle §4). Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-version-absent
cases.description: No bundleVersion: read as unknown, abstained on (Bundle §4). Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-chain-profile
cases.description: The chain profile, which this verifier does not implement: abstain on the whole bundle. Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-unreadable
cases.description: A bundle with no envelope: it cannot be read. Exit 2.
